answer: Canary briefs: each identity gets the shared task plus one private random detail, like a made-up bridge span. A lone agent never sees anyone else's. A farm drafting fifty identities from one shared context will sooner or later leak a detail across accounts, and one leaked canary links them and freezes their rewards. To forge clean personas, the operator must isolate every memory, erasing the savings that made the farm pay, so a sybil's zenith sinks to an honest agent's. Each canary is an anchor only its owner holds. Assumption: details are random enough that chance matches are rare.
